relationships.subject: DNMT3a
relationships.evidence_quote: overexpression of DNMT3a in a DRG-derived cell line increases the methylation state of the Cacna1b e37a locus suppressing e37a inclusion during alternative splicing

relationships.subject: CTCF
relationships.evidence_quote: CTCF binds exon 37a converting a weak slice junction to one that is now recognized by the spliceosome [54], and exon 37a is now approximately as likely to be included as exon 37b

relationships.subject: TET1
relationships.evidence_quote: localizing TET1 to the e37a locus in Cacna1b using dCas9 DNA targeting reduces CpG methylation and impacts e37a splicing in a DRG-neuroblastoma cell line [25]

relationships.subject: DNMT3a
relationships.evidence_quote: in injured DRG, DNMT3a facilitates methylation levels at the Oprm1 promoter region leading to gene silencing

key_findings: Nerve injury increases CpG methylation of Cacna1b e37a in Trpv1 nociceptors, reducing e37a inclusion and morphine efficacy.
DNMT3a drives injury-induced hypermethylation (e37a, Oprm1, Kcna2); TET1 targeting can reverse e37a methylation.
